theme: Light theme preferred for field-usability and daytime visibility. Clean, corporate, and rugged.

headings.rules: Never use Inter for headings. Use tight letter spacing (tracking-tight) for large text. No Space Grotesk.

body.rules: Highly legible for dense directory data.

colors.rules: Use deep blues and slate grays. Tint neutral grays with blue. Never use transparent background over content. High contrast for readability in sunlight.

visual_enhancers.surfaces: Technical Grid Borders. Expose the skeleton. Use cardless list items with 1px border-b instead of floating cards with drop shadows.
visual_enhancers.borders: 1px solid border-slate-200. Max border-radius: 8px for buttons/inputs.
visual_enhancers.icons: Phosphor Icons (@phosphor-icons/react) for crisp, professional tech look.

grids.mobile: Single column list flow for directory entries.
grids.desktop: grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-3 for directory items. Dense gaps (gap-4).

layouts.alignment: Optical alignment over geometrical. Left-align text, directory items, and lists.
layouts.containers: DO NOT center align the app container. Remove default React text-align: center.
layouts.navigation: Bottom tab bar for mobile (Directory, Account, Admin) to ensure thumb-reachability in the field.
layouts.header: Sticky header with SOLID background (bg-white or bg-slate-900) and z-50. NO transparency.

motion.rules: Micro-interactions for field usability. Hover states must change text color (e.g., hover:bg-slate-900 hover:text-white). Do NOT use 'transition: all'. Use specific transitions.

accessibility.contrast: APCA standard. Text below 18px must have minimum 4.5:1 ratio.
accessibility.touch_targets: Minimum 44px touch targets for mobile field users.
accessibility.testing: All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a data-testid attribute.

media.images_constraints: Max height 80vh on mobile. Use semantic overlay bg-black/50 if text is on top.

3d_libraries.usage: Not required for this dense utility directory application. Focus on fast 2D rendering and data clarity.

container_yards.description: Use as headers or placeholder avatars for Container Yard entities, or login background.

ceramic_companies.description: Use as category imagery or login hero for Morvi Ceramic section.

instructions_to_main_agent: Ensure the project uses .js/.jsx files for React components, NOT .tsx. Modify any Shadcn imports or implementations to standard JavaScript.
Remove default boilerplate in App.css and index.css that centers the layout (.App { text-align: center }).
Use Shadcn UI logic but deeply customize styles: remove excessive padding/shadows for directory items. Use 1px bottom borders.
Build a persistent solid background header and a sticky search bar directly below it. DO NOT use transparency in headers.
Add 'data-testid' to ALL interactive elements (search input, tabs, map links, login buttons, list items).
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: Avoid generic centered layouts, simplistic gradients, and uniform styling.
Dark colors look good when used independently without gradients. DO NOT use dark colors as gradients.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy, but keep utility lists dense.
You MUST NOT apply universal transition (transition: all). Use specific properties.
You MUST NOT center align the app container. Remove .App { text-align: center; }.
Always use modern button styles like pill-shaped, or sharp button with interaction animations.
NEVER use AI assistant Emoji characters like 🤖🧠💭💡🔮🎯 for icons.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, active states.
Use 2-3x more spacing for section padding, but keep directory lists dense and scannable.
GENERAL UI UX DESIGN GUIDELINES: Prioritize optical alignment. Left-align lists, forms, and paragraphs.
Mobile-first means using bottom tab bars for primary navigation to ease thumb reach.
Ensure touch targets are large enough (min 44px) for logistics workers in the field.
Sticky search bar is critical for instant filtering.
Use Google Maps clickable icons as primary actions on list items (use Phosphor MapPin).
